terms.grammar: adjective, with mēnsis; also a masculine noun (sc. mēnsis)
terms.comment: The month of the februa, rites of purification (Ov. F. 2.19, 31, rightly: de Vaan 208, s.v. februum). Kalendae, Nōnae, Īdūs Februāriae: the 1st, 5th and 13th. In a leap year the extra day falls before the Kalends of March (see leap year).

phrases.latin: vīdī nōn tantum mēnse Februāriō positās, sed etiam Mārtiō exāctō
phrases.english: I have seen vines planted not only in February but even at the end of March
